title: "Unvalidated pairs analysis"
output: html_document

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(here)
library(ggplot2)
library(Matrix)
library(sceptre)
```

# Setup: load shared data

Reproduces the key loading steps from `results_statistics.Rmd` to identify the 34
significant pairs and build the per-sample significance matrix.

```{r load-data, message=FALSE}
# gRNA target mapping
grna_target_df <- fread(
  here("results/2026-05-11_SCEPTRE/tables/grna_target_data_frame.tsv"),
  data.table = FALSE
)

# Table S3 – WTC11, tested elements only
table_s3_path <- here(
  "data/Table_S3_Final_DC_TAP_Seq_Results_w_Chromatin_Categories_on_resized_and_merged_elements_250908_append.tsv"
)
table_s3 <- fread(table_s3_path, data.table = FALSE)
table_s3_wtc11 <- table_s3[table_s3$cell_type == "WTC11", ]
tested_elements <- unique(grna_target_df$grna_target)
table_s3_wtc11 <- table_s3_wtc11[
  table_s3_wtc11$intended_target_name_hg38 %in% tested_elements,
]
table_s3_wtc11$element_category[is.na(table_s3_wtc11$element_category)] <- "Other"

sig_pairs <- table_s3_wtc11[table_s3_wtc11$significant == TRUE, ]
sig_pairs$element_category[is.na(sig_pairs$element_category)] <- "Other"
message("Significant pairs in Table S3: ", nrow(sig_pairs))
```

```{r load-sceptre-results, message=FALSE}
# GENCODE v32 gene symbol lookup
gencode_v32_path <- here("data/gencode.v32.primary_assembly.annotation.gtf.gz")
gencode_genes <- fread(
  cmd   = paste("gzip -dc", shQuote(gencode_v32_path)),
  sep   = "\t", header = FALSE, quote = "", data.table = FALSE,
  fill  = TRUE, comment.char = "#"
)
colnames(gencode_genes) <- c(
  "seqname", "source", "feature", "start", "end",
  "score", "strand", "frame", "attribute"
)
gencode_genes <- gencode_genes[gencode_genes$feature == "gene", , drop = FALSE]
gencode_genes$gene_id      <- sub('.*gene_id "([^"]+)".*',   "\\1", gencode_genes$attribute)
gencode_genes$gene_symbol  <- sub('.*gene_name "([^"]+)".*', "\\1", gencode_genes$attribute)
gencode_genes$gene_id_base <- sub("\\..*$", "", gencode_genes$gene_id)
gencode_genes <- unique(gencode_genes[, c("gene_id_base", "gene_symbol")])

# Load all six union results
union_dirs <- c(
  "MOI1_1_union", "MOI1_5_union", "low_moi_merged_union",
  "MOI11_3_union", "MOI13_union", "high_moi_merged_union"
)
sceptre_list <- lapply(union_dirs, function(d) {
  p <- here("results/2026-05-11_SCEPTRE/runs", d, "sceptre_discovery_results.tsv")
  if (!file.exists(p)) { message("Missing: ", p); return(NULL) }
  r <- fread(p, data.table = FALSE)
  r$source <- d
  r
})
sceptre_all <- do.call(rbind, Filter(Negate(is.null), sceptre_list))
sceptre_all$response_id_base <- sub("\\..*$", "", sceptre_all$response_id)
sceptre_all <- merge(
  sceptre_all, gencode_genes,
  by.x = "response_id_base", by.y = "gene_id_base",
  all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE
)
sceptre_all$element_gene_pair_identifier_hg38 <-
  paste(sceptre_all$gene_symbol, sceptre_all$grna_target, sep = "|")

# Build significance matrix (34 sig pairs × 6 sources)
source_order <- c(
  "MOI1_1_union", "MOI1_5_union", "low_moi_merged_union",
  "MOI11_3_union", "MOI13_union", "high_moi_merged_union"
)
source_labels <- c("low_1", "low_2", "low_merged", "high_1", "high_2", "high_merged")

pairs_mask <- sceptre_all$element_gene_pair_identifier_hg38 %in%
  sig_pairs$element_gene_pair_identifier_hg38
plot_df <- sceptre_all[pairs_mask, ]

heat_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    sig_int = ifelse(is.na(significant), 0L, as.integer(significant)),
    source  = factor(source, levels = source_order)
  ) %>%
  select(element_gene_pair_identifier_hg38, source, sig_int) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  complete(
    element_gene_pair_identifier_hg38,
    source = factor(source_order, levels = source_order),
    fill = list(sig_int = 0L)
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = source, values_from = sig_int)

heat_mat <- as.matrix(heat_df[, -1])
rownames(heat_mat) <- heat_df$element_gene_pair_identifier_hg38
colnames(heat_mat) <- source_labels

message("Significance matrix: ", nrow(heat_mat), " pairs × ", ncol(heat_mat), " samples")
```

---

# 1. Which of the 34 pairs are never validated?

```{r never-validated}
n_samples_sig <- rowSums(heat_mat)
never_validated_ids  <- names(which(n_samples_sig == 0))
always_validated_ids <- names(which(n_samples_sig > 0))

cat("Never validated in any sample:  ", length(never_validated_ids),  "\n")
cat("Validated in at least one sample:", length(always_validated_ids), "\n")
```

## Table S3 metadata for never-validated pairs

```{r never-validated-table}
meta_cols <- c(
  "element_gene_pair_identifier_hg38",
  "gene_symbol",
  "intended_target_name_hg38",
  "element_category",
  "significant",
  "pct_change_effect_size",
  "distance_to_gencode_gene_TSS",
  "power_at_effect_size_2_wo_pos_controls_20fdr",
  "power_at_effect_size_5_wo_pos_controls_20fdr",
  "power_at_effect_size_10_wo_pos_controls_20fdr",
  "power_at_effect_size_20_wo_pos_controls_20fdr",
  "power_at_effect_size_50_wo_pos_controls_20fdr"
)
# Keep only columns that exist
meta_cols <- intersect(meta_cols, colnames(sig_pairs))

never_meta <- sig_pairs[
  sig_pairs$element_gene_pair_identifier_hg38 %in% never_validated_ids,
  meta_cols
]
never_meta <- never_meta[order(never_meta$element_category), ]

knitr::kable(never_meta, row.names = FALSE,
             caption = "Never-validated pairs – Table S3 metadata")
```

## Comparison: effect size and power

```{r effect-size-comparison}
sig_pairs$validation_status <- ifelse(
  sig_pairs$element_gene_pair_identifier_hg38 %in% never_validated_ids,
  "Never validated", "Validated ≥1 sample"
)

category_order <- c(
  "High H3K27ac", "H3K27ac", "No H3K27ac",
  "CTCF element", "H3K27me3 element", "Other"
)
color_values <- c("#c5373d", "#d9694a", "#c5cad7", "#49bcbc", "#429130", "grey80")
color_map <- setNames(color_values, category_order)

ggplot(sig_pairs,
       aes(x = validation_status, y = pct_change_effect_size,
           fill = element_category)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = element_category), width = 0.15, size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = color_map) +
  scale_color_manual(values = color_map) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Effect size (% change) – validated vs never-validated",
    x = NULL, y = "% Change effect size",
    fill = "Category", color = "Category"
  )
```

```{r distance-to-tss-comparison}
ggplot(sig_pairs,
       aes(x = validation_status,
           y = abs(distance_to_gencode_gene_TSS) / 1000,
           fill = element_category)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = element_category), width = 0.15, size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = color_map) +
  scale_color_manual(values = color_map) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Distance to TSS – validated vs never-validated",
    x = NULL, y = "|Distance to TSS| (kb, log10)",
    fill = "Category", color = "Category"
  )
```

```{r power-comparison}
power_cols_plot <- c(
  "power_at_effect_size_5_wo_pos_controls_20fdr",
  "power_at_effect_size_10_wo_pos_controls_20fdr",
  "power_at_effect_size_20_wo_pos_controls_20fdr",
  "power_at_effect_size_50_wo_pos_controls_20fdr"
)
power_cols_plot <- intersect(power_cols_plot, colnames(sig_pairs))

power_long <- sig_pairs %>%
  select(element_gene_pair_identifier_hg38, validation_status, all_of(power_cols_plot)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(power_cols_plot), names_to = "effect_size", values_to = "power") %>%
  mutate(
    effect_size = sub("power_at_effect_size_(.*)_wo_pos_controls_20fdr", "ES=\\1%", effect_size)
  )

ggplot(power_long, aes(x = effect_size, y = power, fill = validation_status)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Never validated" = "#d73027", "Validated ≥1 sample" = "#1a9850")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Power estimates – validated vs never-validated",
    x = "Effect size used for power calculation",
    y = "Power (20% FDR)",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

# 2. Gene expression: mean UMI per gene per cell (high_moi_merged)

```{r load-sceptre-object, message=FALSE}
message("Loading high_moi_merged post-pipeline SCEPTRE object …")
sceptre_obj <- readRDS(
  here("results/2026-05-11_SCEPTRE/runs/high_moi_merged_union/sceptre_object_post_pipeline.rds")
)
response_mat <- sceptre_obj@response_matrix[[1]]  # dgRMatrix: genes × cells
message("Response matrix: ", nrow(response_mat), " genes × ", ncol(response_mat), " cells")
```

```{r gene-mean-umi}
# Map sig_pairs gene symbols to ENSG IDs
sig_pairs_ensg <- merge(
  sig_pairs[, c("element_gene_pair_identifier_hg38", "gene_symbol", "validation_status")],
  gencode_genes,
  by = "gene_symbol",
  all.x = TRUE
)
# Keep genes that are in the response matrix
sig_pairs_ensg$ensg_full <- rownames(response_mat)[
  match(sig_pairs_ensg$gene_id_base,
        sub("\\..*$", "", rownames(response_mat)))
]
sig_pairs_ensg <- sig_pairs_ensg[!is.na(sig_pairs_ensg$ensg_full), ]

# Compute mean UMI per cell for each gene
genes_to_test <- unique(sig_pairs_ensg$ensg_full)
gene_mean_umi <- data.frame(
  ensg_full = genes_to_test,
  mean_umi_per_cell = Matrix::rowMeans(response_mat[genes_to_test, , drop = FALSE]),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Attach validation status (a gene may appear in both groups if it has multiple elements;
# take the "better" status: validated if it has any validated pair)
gene_status <- sig_pairs_ensg %>%
  group_by(ensg_full, gene_symbol) %>%
  summarise(
    validation_status = ifelse(
      any(validation_status == "Validated ≥1 sample"),
      "Validated ≥1 sample", "Never validated"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

gene_expr <- merge(gene_mean_umi, gene_status, by = "ensg_full")
message("Genes with expression data: ", nrow(gene_expr))
print(gene_expr[order(gene_expr$validation_status, -gene_expr$mean_umi_per_cell),
               c("gene_symbol", "validation_status", "mean_umi_per_cell")])
```

```{r gene-expression-plot}
ggplot(gene_expr, aes(x = validation_status, y = mean_umi_per_cell + 0.001,
                      fill = validation_status)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.7, draw_quantiles = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, size = 3, alpha = 0.9,
              aes(color = validation_status)) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = gene_symbol),
    size = 3, max.overlaps = 20
  ) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = c("Never validated" = "#d73027", "Validated ≥1 sample" = "#1a9850")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Never validated" = "#d73027", "Validated ≥1 sample" = "#1a9850")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Mean UMI per gene per cell (high_moi_merged)",
    subtitle = "Genes from the 34 significant pairs",
    x = NULL, y = "Mean UMI per cell (log10 scale)",
    fill = NULL, color = NULL
  )
```

```{r gene-expression-wilcoxon}
wt <- wilcox.test(
  mean_umi_per_cell ~ validation_status,
  data = gene_expr,
  exact = FALSE
)
cat("Wilcoxon test – mean UMI per cell (Validated vs Never):\n")
cat("  W =", wt$statistic, "  p =", round(wt$p.value, 4), "\n")
```

# 3. Element guide coverage: total UMI per element (high_moi_merged)

```{r guide-umi-per-element}
grna_mat <- sceptre_obj@grna_matrix[[1]]  # dgRMatrix: guides × cells
message("Guide matrix: ", nrow(grna_mat), " guides × ", ncol(grna_mat), " cells")

# Sum all guide UMIs per guide across cells
guide_total_umi <- data.frame(
  grna_id   = rownames(grna_mat),
  total_umi = Matrix::rowSums(grna_mat),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Map guides to elements via grna_target_data_frame
guide_total_umi <- merge(
  guide_total_umi,
  grna_target_df[, c("grna_id", "grna_target")],
  by = "grna_id",
  all.x = TRUE
)

# Keep only elements that are in the 34 sig pairs
sig_elements <- unique(sig_pairs$intended_target_name_hg38)
guide_total_umi_sig <- guide_total_umi[guide_total_umi$grna_target %in% sig_elements, ]

# Sum UMI per element and count guides
element_umi <- guide_total_umi_sig %>%
  group_by(grna_target) %>%
  summarise(
    total_umi    = sum(total_umi),
    n_guides     = n(),
    mean_umi_per_guide = mean(total_umi),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rename(intended_target_name_hg38 = grna_target)

# Attach validation status: an element is "validated" if any of its pairs is validated
element_status <- sig_pairs %>%
  group_by(intended_target_name_hg38) %>%
  summarise(
    validation_status = ifelse(
      any(validation_status == "Validated ≥1 sample"),
      "Validated ≥1 sample", "Never validated"
    ),
    element_category = first(element_category),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

element_umi <- merge(element_umi, element_status,
                     by = "intended_target_name_hg38")
message("Elements with guide data: ", nrow(element_umi))
print(element_umi[order(element_umi$validation_status, -element_umi$total_umi), ])
```

```{r element-total-umi-plot}
ggplot(element_umi, aes(x = validation_status, y = total_umi + 1,
                        fill = validation_status)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.7, draw_quantiles = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, size = 3, alpha = 0.9,
              aes(color = element_category)) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = c("Never validated" = "#d73027", "Validated ≥1 sample" = "#1a9850")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = color_map) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Total guide UMI per element (high_moi_merged)",
    subtitle = "Sum of all guide UMIs assigned to each element across all cells",
    x = NULL, y = "Total guide UMI (log10 scale)",
    fill = "Validation status", color = "Element category"
  )
```

```{r element-mean-umi-per-guide-plot}
ggplot(element_umi, aes(x = validation_status, y = mean_umi_per_guide + 1,
                        fill = validation_status)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.7, draw_quantiles = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, size = 3, alpha = 0.9,
              aes(color = element_category)) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = c("Never validated" = "#d73027", "Validated ≥1 sample" = "#1a9850")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = color_map) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Mean guide UMI per guide per element (high_moi_merged)",
    subtitle = "Average per-guide UMI within each element",
    x = NULL, y = "Mean UMI per guide (log10 scale)",
    fill = "Validation status", color = "Element category"
  )
```

```{r element-umi-wilcoxon}
wt_el <- wilcox.test(
  total_umi ~ validation_status,
  data = element_umi,
  exact = FALSE
)
cat("Wilcoxon test – total guide UMI per element (Validated vs Never):\n")
cat("  W =", wt_el$statistic, "  p =", round(wt_el$p.value, 4), "\n")
```

# 4. Summary

```{r summary-table}
summary_df <- sig_pairs %>%
  select(element_gene_pair_identifier_hg38, gene_symbol,
         intended_target_name_hg38, element_category,
         pct_change_effect_size, validation_status) %>%
  left_join(
    gene_expr[, c("gene_symbol", "mean_umi_per_cell")],
    by = "gene_symbol"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    element_umi[, c("intended_target_name_hg38", "total_umi", "n_guides")],
    by = "intended_target_name_hg38"
  ) %>%
  arrange(validation_status, element_category,
          desc(abs(pct_change_effect_size)))

knitr::kable(
  summary_df,
  digits = 2,
  caption = "All 34 significant pairs with expression and guide coverage metrics"
)
```
